overview_description.description: Supabase provides an open source backend platform for application development, centered around a managed PostgreSQL database and complementary tools. It offers built-in user authentication, real-time subscriptions, file storage, and serverless edge functions within a unified interface. Supabase enabling developers to deploy secure databases quickly, auto-generate APIs, and focus on building features rather than infrastructure. The company operates with a commitment to open source, contributing to database extensions and community projects. It supports integration with existing Postgres setups and encourages flexibility in scaling and migration.

product.name: Supabase Database
product.description: A managed PostgreSQL database with an API layer for storing, querying, and securing application data.

product.name: Supabase Auth
product.description: An authentication and user-management service for implementing sign-up, login, identity providers, sessions, and access controls.

product.name: Supabase Storage
product.description: An object storage service for uploading, organizing, securing, and serving files such as images, videos, and documents.

product.name: Supabase Realtime
product.description: A real-time data service that delivers database changes and application events to connected clients.

product.name: Supabase Edge Functions
product.description: A serverless runtime for deploying backend logic and APIs close to application users.

product.name: Supabase Vector
product.description: A PostgreSQL-based vector storage and similarity-search capability for applications using embeddings and AI data.
